subject: Myth & Symbolism
title: Seven Chakras
description: A fast breakdown of Seven Chakras for builders.

hook.text: Hindu tradition maps seven energy centers along the spine—from base to crown. Each chakra governs a domain.

buildup.text: Root chakra: survival. Sacral: creativity. Solar plexus: power. Heart: love. Throat: truth. Third eye. Crown.

discovery.text: Kundalini energy rises through all seven. When it reaches the crown, enlightenment occurs. Seven is the path.

twist.text: Western wellness adopted chakras but stripped the theology. What was theology became spa culture.

climax.text: The chakra system maps spiritual progress as a vertical climb—seven stages from animal instinct to divine light.

punchline.text: Seven levels. One spine. The body is a ladder.

quiz.question: What happens when kundalini energy reaches the seventh chakra?
